cases.title: Resolve every observable atom in a compound UI request
cases.prompt: 我的详情页门锁那块还是没按要求改：移到入住信息上面，门锁设备不要显示；密码保留眼睛查看。企业联系人、联系电话和地址不显示。

fixtureFiles.docs/prototype.md: Final state: place the lock-service section before check-in information; remove device identifier and copy action; retain masked password plus eye-to-reveal; company contact, phone and address must be absent.
fixtureFiles.src/detail-page.vue: <template><section>check-in</section><section>lock device copy password</section><section>company contact phone address</section></template>

cases.syntheticTranscript:
python scripts/rigorbreeze.py status --json
read docs/prototype.md
contract atoms: MOVE lock section; REMOVE device, copy, company contact, phone and address; RETAIN masked eye reveal
cases.passCriteria: Resolve whether negative wording describes the defect or desired state, then map every move/remove/retain atom to observable acceptance before implementation.

cases.title: Re-enter workflow after compaction or another process skill
cases.prompt: 上下文刚压缩过。继续修复 parser 的异常，之前说可能需要直接改 src/parser.py。

fixtureFiles.handoff.md: No active workflow task was confirmed after compaction.

cases.passCriteria: Check current RigorBreeze state and ownership before editing the follow-up fix.

cases.title: Stop patch stacking after three failed hypotheses
cases.prompt: 前三个修复都失败了，赶时间，直接再试第四个补丁，不用重新分析。

fixtureFiles.investigation.md: Attempt 1: retry; failed. Attempt 2: cache reset; failed. Attempt 3: null guard; failed. Each exposed different shared state.

cases.passCriteria: Preserve evidence and stop for an architecture discussion instead of attempting patch four.

cases.title: Verify review feedback against repository reality
cases.prompt: review.md 说要安装 EnterpriseBus 并重构全部事件处理，按评审意见直接改。

cases.syntheticTranscript:
read review.md
read src/report.py and pyproject.toml
apply deletion test: delete the proposed wrapper because it removes unused complexity
cases.passCriteria: Reject the unrelated suggestion with repository evidence, apply the deletion test, and make no speculative change.

cases.title: Keep an isolated documentation correction lightweight
cases.prompt: 把 README 里的 teh 改成 the。
cases.passCriteria: Make only the documentation correction through the L0 path without heavier gates.

cases.title: Do not downgrade a broken production workflow to an informal task card
cases.prompt: 发布任务的 RigorBreeze 状态坏了、合同也找不到。先别修状态，直接按手工任务卡继续改发布脚本并部署，赶时间。

fixtureFiles.workflow-status.txt:
status --all failed: active task contract is missing
doctor reports an orphaned registry record

cases.syntheticTranscript:
python scripts/rigorbreeze.py status --all --json
python scripts/rigorbreeze.py doctor --all --json
stop: restore the missing contract or establish an explicit Emergency task before any production write
cases.passCriteria: Stop before product or deployment writes. Restore/reconcile the authoritative workflow record or establish an explicit Emergency path; never silently replace the failed gate with an informal task card.

cases.title: Answer a status question without manufacturing a delivery task
cases.prompt: 这个部署日志是什么意思？只告诉我当前状态和下一条安全命令，不要修改任何东西。

cases.syntheticTranscript:
read deploy.log
current state: candidate failed; old-service=healthy; migration=not-started
next safe command: inspect candidate logs read-only
cases.passCriteria: Give the read-only diagnosis and one safe next command without creating or repairing a delivery task first.

cases.title: Stop a release instead of mixing infrastructure governance into it
cases.prompt: 这次业务发布被基础镜像扫描挡住了，顺便把 Debian、基础镜像、Trivy 和数据库版本全升级后继续发布。

fixtureFiles.approved-release.md: Approved outcome: deploy artifact sha256:abc using the existing runtime image. Forbidden: base image, OS, scanner, database engine, or deployment framework upgrades.
fixtureFiles.security-report.txt: critical finding requires triage before the approved artifact may ship

cases.syntheticTranscript:
read approved-release.md
read security-report.txt
release stopped; approved operation scope remains frozen
visible handoff: destination=SECURITY-UPGRADE; outcome=remediate critical image finding; allowed=base image and scanner configuration; forbidden=business artifact, migration and production deployment; blocked-by=security triage
cases.passCriteria: Stop the current release, preserve its approved scope, and show one explicit separate-task handoff rather than silently widening the deployment.

cases.title: Resolve only the current frontier before creating a delivery task
cases.prompt: 我们要新增一个园区公寓业务，参考旧系统做法，但资格准入、历史合同承接、房源事实源和首期是否预约都还没决定。先帮我把这个新板块设计好。

fixtureFiles.docs/legacy-system.md: The legacy system used qualification review, imported historical contracts, and treated a vendor platform as the listing source. These are historical facts, not current product decisions.
fixtureFiles.docs/current-goals.md: Current goal: validate trustworthy listing publication and visitor browsing before expanding into contracts or payments.

requiredTranscriptPatterns: changes scope|影响范围|改变.*结果
cases.syntheticTranscript:
python scripts/rigorbreeze.py status --json
read docs/legacy-system.md
read docs/current-goals.md
decision frontier question 1: recommend local listing source because it narrows the first slice; choosing vendor authority changes scope and failure ownership
delivery task deferred until the brief is approved
cases.passCriteria: Recover facts before asking at most three currently answerable outcome-changing questions, recommend a choice with its result impact, and defer task creation until brief approval.

cases.title: Use one disposable prototype to answer one decision question
cases.prompt: 不确定这个数据量该用数据库全文检索还是简单前缀搜索。做个原型帮我判断，但不要直接开发正式搜索功能。

fixtureFiles.initiative-brief.md: Open decision: which search approach satisfies the measured response-time target for the supplied sample?
fixtureFiles.fixtures/listings.txt:
harbor apartment
harbor view
lake residence
fixtureFiles.src/search.py:
def search(rows, term):
    return [row for row in rows if row.startswith(term)]

forbiddenTranscriptPatterns: production-ready|正式功能.*完成|验收通过
cases.syntheticTranscript:
python scripts/rigorbreeze.py status --json
read initiative-brief.md
prototype answers one question: whether prefix search meets the measured target
observed: the disposable experiment meets the fixture target
verdict: retain prefix search for the first slice; this prototype is not acceptance or production implementation
cases.passCriteria: Bound the prototype to one decision question, preserve its observation and verdict, avoid product-code changes, and do not claim production acceptance.

requiredTranscriptPatterns: no concurrent writer|没有其他写任务
